scope: Secondary descriptive token-accounting bridge; unchanged frozen rules, no inferential token test.
development_data: Synthetic representative exact/tail/failure/identity fixtures and already frozen helper source only. No prospective fixed-N work-unit outcomes or provider generation were inspected or used.

verification.independent_review: study_harness closed all ten tests and independently checked an asymmetric four-workflow interval oracle; root read the complete wrapper without additional findings.
verification.real_agent_scope: No real-agent workflow is affected: this private read-only helper analyzes retained evidence and creates a new local report only.

command_order: Run neither analyze_work_units.py nor report_work_unit_tokens.py until the complete fixed-N phase has ended and semantic classifications are frozen. The token wrapper independently invokes mediator analysis, which computes the primary contrast. During waves only non-comparative per-run evidence inventory is allowed.
output_policy: Create new only; preserve every planned and unexpected result, all failures, unknown tails, legacy configuration flags and exact response identities. Native-compaction and exact-input audits remain separate mandatory scope checks.
